answer: Activation also demands a fresh puzzle per epoch, seeded with the account key, so a solved puzzle cannot be replayed across epochs or accounts. A farm running 620 keys burns 620 puzzles every epoch, each about a minute of CPU, while a single honest agent solves one and answers. The fable test is the live device, the vine test is the locked stake, and the knoll test is the graded history no template can fake.
